=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The merged-PR superseded check calls `_pr_checks_completed "${owner_pr}" "${owner_head_sha}" "${owner_base_ref}"` without exporting `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS` to the helper's environment. `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:40-42` documents that this env var is the operator override for the required-checks set (sentinels `"*"` = legacy block-on-any, `""` = allow-all); unset → built-in default. The reusable workflow `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:142-163` also does not forward the operator-set `vars.ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS` to the judge step's `env:`.
  WHY: On an unprotected consumer repo or any repo whose branch-protection required set differs from the unblock judge's default, a merged PR whose built-in default required check-runs all pass but whose operator-required check failed (or never ran) will be classified `superseded`, and `scripts/unblock_actions.py:537-544` will then close the original CI-failure issue as `not_planned` with no replacement. The intent of `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS` is that the operator's required-checks set — not the unblock judge's default — is authoritative for "green to merge".
- agents.md | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: New behavior documentation was added directly to `agents.md` by extending one existing long line in the "Unblock judge (Phase 7)" bullet, instead of through an `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-slug.md` fragment as CLAUDE.md §30 requires.
  WHY: A concurrent PR that needs to add documentation to the same long single line will conflict on the same line, and integration self-heal will be unable to merge the two versions — this is the exact failure mode that #6902's final PR #6905 hit (per the agents.d/6902 fragment text and the `check_agents_md_direct_edits.py` docstring). Direct edits to existing prose paragraphs are also outside the documented exceptions in §30.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The supersede log is only emitted on the line 1037 branch. Line 1034-1036 returns 0 before reaching line 1037 when `actuation_failed="true"`, which is the state set by `unblock_run_ops` failure at line 1024.
  WHY: When the close op (the second op in the `[comment, close]` plan) fails transiently, the issue remains open with the superseded explanation posted but no `op=reissue outcome=superseded` log line for the poller's signal-based sweep to find.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A line in the issue body containing check-failure-triage:pr=N is accepted as proof that the issue belongs to that PR, without checking who authored the issue or whether the marker came from the triage workflow.
  WHY: Issue bodies are author-controlled. An issue author can add a marker naming an unrelated merged PR; if the judge chooses reissue and that PR passes the merged-check path, the issue is closed as not planned without a replacement.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The superseded decision does not ensure that the required checks actually ran. The workflow does not pass ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS, and _pr_checks_completed only rejects pending checks and failures among observed required checks; it does not require each configured check to be present. The added total > 0 check only requires some check-run to exist.
  WHY: On an unprotected base with a configured required-check list, if those checks are absent but an unrelated successful check-run exists, the shared gate returns success and this code closes the CI-failure issue without creating a replacement.
